english_name: National Health Insurance Program (JKN BPJS Kesehatan)
target_users: Foreign residents residing and working in Indonesia for at least 6 months
eligibility_conditions: Indonesian citizen holding NIK KTP or foreign resident holding valid KITAS/KITAP and work contract >= 6 months
Enrolled in one of the membership categories: PPU (formal worker), PBPU (independent), BP (non-worker), or PBI (subsidized)
Active contribution payment status without unpaid premium arrears
coverage_territory: Entire territory of the Republic of Indonesia across contracted healthcare facilities
published_pricing_conditions: PBPU Mandiri monthly contribution: Kelas 1 IDR 150,000; Kelas 2 IDR 100,000; Kelas 3 IDR 35,000 (after government subsidy)

benefits.benefit_name: Pelayanan Kesehatan Tingkat Pertama (Rawat Jalan Tingkat Pertama - RJTP)
benefits.original_name: Rawat Jalan Tingkat Pertama (RJTP) di FKTP Terdaftar
benefits.covered_event: Non-emergency illness or consultation covered under primary care competencies
benefits.covered_service: Doctor consultation, preventive services, health counseling, laboratory diagnostics according to primary clinic capacity, prescription medicines on Formularium Nasional (Fornas)
eligibility_conditions: Active membership with registered FKTP (Puskesmas or primary clinic)
benefits.network_requirements: Must visit registered FKTP clinic on participant card (except medical emergencies)
evidence_references: Active KIS digital card in Mobile JKN application

benefits.benefit_name: Pelayanan Rawat Inap Tingkat Lanjutan (RITL) di Rumah Sakit
benefits.original_name: Rawat Inap Tingkat Lanjutan (RITL) di FKRTL
benefits.covered_event: Inpatient hospitalization for surgical or non-surgical disease requiring hospital care
benefits.covered_service: Hospital room, intensive care unit (ICU, ICCU, PICU, NICU), surgery, anesthesia, specialist consultations, diagnostic imaging, medicine in Fornas
eligibility_conditions: Official electronic referral letter (Surat Rujukan) from FKTP or direct emergency admission
benefits.network_requirements: Contracted public or private hospitals (FKRTL) in BPJS network
benefits.reimbursement_rate: 100% under INA-CBGs tariff package with no out-of-pocket payment when following standard class
evidence_references: Hospital admission order (Surat Eligibilitas Peserta - SEP)

benefits.benefit_name: Pelayanan Kegawatdaruratan Medis (Instalasi Gawat Darurat - IGD)
benefits.original_name: Pelayanan Gawat Darurat di IGD Rumah Sakit
benefits.covered_event: Life-threatening emergency, organ danger, severe acute trauma meeting criteria of Permenkes No. 47 Tahun 2018
benefits.covered_service: Emergency resuscitation, emergency stabilization, medication, immediate life-saving surgery
eligibility_conditions: Meets medical emergency criteria; no prior referral letter required
benefits.network_requirements: Any hospital emergency room (IGD) in Indonesia, contracted or non-contracted
evidence_references: SEP Gawat Darurat generated by hospital emergency desk

exclusions.excluded_event_or_service: Non-emergency healthcare obtained at hospital specialist clinics without primary referral from FKTP
exclusions.original_text: Pelayanan kesehatan yang dilakukan tanpa melalui prosedur rujukan dari Fasilitas Kesehatan Tingkat Pertama, kecuali dalam keadaan gawat darurat
exclusions.conditions_and_exceptions: True medical emergencies entering through the Emergency Department (IGD) are exempted
territorial_exclusions: Healthcare services received outside the territory of Indonesia
exclusions.pre_existing_condition_provisions: No pre-existing condition exclusions in JKN social health insurance
exclusions.supporting_policy_clause: Perpres No. 59 Tahun 2024 Pasal 52 ayat (1) huruf b

exclusions.excluded_event_or_service: Cosmetic, aesthetic, and non-medically necessary plastic surgeries
exclusions.original_text: Pelayanan kesehatan untuk tujuan estetik atau kosmetik
exclusions.conditions_and_exceptions: Reconstructive surgery required following severe accidental trauma or burn is covered
exclusions.supporting_policy_clause: Perpres No. 59 Tahun 2024 Pasal 52 ayat (1) huruf f

exclusions.excluded_event_or_service: Infertility treatments, in vitro fertilization (IVF), and elective vasectomy/tubectomy reversal
exclusions.original_text: Pelayanan untuk mengatasi infertilitas atau program mendapatkan keturunan
exclusions.supporting_policy_clause: Perpres No. 59 Tahun 2024 Pasal 52 ayat (1) huruf h
